headline: Kyiv Under Siege: Russia Launches Massive Coordinated 12-Strike Drone-Missile Blitz
subheadline: Twelve Russian projectiles—including ballistic missiles, Shaheds, Zircon, and Geran‑5 drones—struck Kyiv’s left and right banks, hitting TEC‑6 warehouses and Sviatoshynskyi depots.
lede: Russia launched a massive multi‑axis drone and missile campaign against Kyiv, delivering twelve strikes across both riverbanks, including two ballistic missiles, multiple Shaheds, Zircon missiles, and Geran‑5 jet drones that degraded Ukrainian air defenses to roughly 60% effectiveness. In the Middle East, IDF operations eliminated three Hamas/PIJ operatives in Gaza, captured senior PIJ member Mohammed Saadi in the West Bank, and struck southern Lebanon, while Houthi‑US talks in Muscat produced a pledge to avoid attacks on US ships. A Houthi ballistic missile was intercepted over Mecca, prompting Turkish condemnation, and Saudi Arabia announced plans to restore half of the east‑west oil pipeline within days.

sections.title: Kyiv Targeted by 12‑Strike Russian Assault
sections.body: Twelve Russian projectiles—including ballistic missiles, Shaheds, Zircon, and Geran‑5 jet drones—struck Kyiv’s left and right banks, hitting TEC‑6 and Sviatoshynskyi warehouses. Russia’s Geran‑5 drones achieved a roughly 60% interception rate, exposing the failure of Ukraine’s new interceptor drone program, which crashed during trials above 400 km/h. Ukrainian military salary funding shortfalls extend two months beyond the budget, while political infighting between the prosecutor’s office and anti‑corruption agencies threatens international support. Multi‑front UAV activity continued from Mykolaiv to Kharkiv, and Chernihiv region drones moved southwest toward Kyiv, with Belarusian relay stations enabling attacks on the Yahodin checkpoint on the Polish border.

sections.title: IDF Multi‑Front Strikes Across Gaza, West Bank, Lebanon
sections.body: IDF operations eliminated three Hamas/PIJ operatives in Gaza, including Nukhba commander Jihad Samih Mahmoud Ismail in Khan Younis, and two Islamic Jihad militants in northern Gaza strikes. The Duvdevan Commando Unit captured senior PIJ member Mohammed Saadi in Burqin near Jenin, linking him to a dismantled 2025 terror network funding attacks against Israelis. US and Houthi representatives met in Muscat, where the Houthis pledged no attacks on US ships and committed to the 2025 ceasefire, though a Houthi ballistic missile was intercepted over Mecca, prompting sharp Turkish condemnation. Saudi Arabia announced plans to restore half of the east‑west oil pipeline’s capacity within days, with full recovery expected in roughly six weeks, while IDF strikes in southern Lebanon generated 126 artillery and drone alerts across Nabatieh, Bint Jbeil, and Marjayoun.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The simultaneous IDF strikes across Gaza, the West Bank, and Lebanon indicate a coordinated multi‑front security posture that could further escalate regional tensions. Russia’s deployment of Geran‑5 jet drones has qualitatively shifted the air war in Ukraine, reducing Ukrainian interception rates to about 60% and exposing critical gaps in air‑defence capabilities. The Houthi pledge in Muscat offers a potential de‑escalation channel, yet the intercepted missile over Mecca and continued UAV activity suggest ongoing threats to Saudi and US interests.
